title: agentarch threat model front matter
description: The structured header of a threat model. The document itself is prose — a threat model that could be fully expressed as data would not be doing the thinking it exists to do.

reviewed_at.description: When a person last read this against the system as it stands. Review is an act someone performed, not a state a file is in.

accepted_risks.description: Every real system has some. A threat model with none was not honest.

invalidated_by.description: Revalidation triggers that make this document describe a system that no longer exists.
